generated.details: At midground far left, a floor-standing fabric rack has a timber base and retaining crossbars holding plain neutral fabric rolls upright around cardboard cores.
On the upper-right background wall, handmade ceramic sample tiles form a spaced grid, each thick square mounted flat with subtly irregular glazed edges.
On the tabletop right of the printer, label-free neutral fabric swatches overlap loosely, showing woven faces and softly frayed cut edges.
Beside them farther right, an unlit studio task lamp has a weighted base, jointed metal arm and attached shallow shade.
